    • getTabletId

      TabletId getTabletId()
      Returns:
      the TabletId for this tablet.

    • getNumFiles

      int getNumFiles()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.FILES to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      the number of files in the tablet directory.

    • getNumWalLogs

      int getNumWalLogs()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.FILES to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      the number of write-ahead logs associated with the tablet.

    • getEstimatedEntries

      long getEstimatedEntries()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.FILES to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      an estimated number of entries in the tablet.

    • getEstimatedSize

      long getEstimatedSize()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.FILES to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      an estimated size of the tablet data on disk, which is likely the compressed size of the data.

    • getTabletState

      String getTabletState()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.LOCATION to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      the tablet hosting state.

    • getLocation

      Optional<String> getLocation()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.LOCATION to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      the Location of the tablet as a String or empty if the location in the TabletMetadata does not exist. When not empty, the String will be of the form "<location type>:<host>:<port>", where the location type is one of CURRENT or FUTURE

    • getTabletDir

      String getTabletDir()
      Requires TabletInformation.Field.FILES to be specified at acquisition otherwise an exception will be thrown.
      Returns:
      the directory name of the tablet.

      Returns:
      the TabletAvailability object.
